title: Addressing Vaccine Acceptance in Carceral Settings Through Community Engagement
official: Addressing Vaccine Acceptance in Carceral Settings Through Community Engagement
summary: The objective of this study is to identify a set of interventions that are effective in improving preventive healthcare engagement, including vaccination and chronic disease prevention, among incarcerated individuals and correctional staff in the Pennsylvania prison system.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All incarcerated people in the Pennsylvania DOC are included in the study population for these low risk interventions. In this each individual intervention, inclusion criteria will be based on where incarcerated people are housed and therefore what intervention they will be exposed to.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Exclusion criteria will likely include severe physical or mental illness as these individuals are often incarcerated in special units which will not be included in the study (i.e. medical units).
